nodes.description: Caller-controlled address used for balance ownership, allowance keys and owner-only assertions.
Public token name string, set once in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor.
Public token decimals value, set once in the constructor.
Total token supply, set in constructor and reduced by burn().
Contract owner address; gates burn, freeze, unfreeze and withdrawEther.
Global freeze flag checked by every token-moving function.
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer/transferFrom/burn.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount used by approve/transferFrom.
Declared per-address freeze mapping that is never read or written.
Mapping of address to arbitrary BTB address string set by setBTBAddress.
internal pure SafeMath.safeMul(uint256 a, uint256 b): multiplies and asserts no overflow.
internal pure SafeMath.safeDiv(uint256 a, uint256 b): divides and asserts consistency.
internal pure SafeMath.safeSub(uint256 a, uint256 b): subtracts after asserting b <= a.
internal pure SafeMath.safeAdd(uint256 a, uint256 b): adds and asserts no overflow.
Constructor: mints 10*10**26 tokens to msg.sender, sets metadata and owner.
external transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): moves tokens from msg.sender with asserts.
external approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
external transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): spends allowance.
external burn(uint256 _value): owner-only supply reduction via SafeMath.safeSub.
external freeze(): owner-only, sets isContractFrozen to true.
external unfreeze(): owner-only, sets isContractFrozen to false.
external setBTBAddress(string btbAddress): stores a string per msg.sender.
external withdrawEther(uint256 amount): owner-only ether payout via owner.transfer.
payable fallback function that accepts ether without any logic.
uint256 c = a * b inside safeMul; raw multiplication checked by assert.
c / a inside the safeMul overflow assert; raw division.
uint256 c = a / b inside safeDiv; raw division.
a % b inside the safeDiv consistency assert; raw modulo.
b * c inside the safeDiv consistency assert; raw multiplication.
b * c + a % b inside the safeDiv assert; raw addition.
return a - b inside safeSub; raw subtraction checked by assert.
uint256 c = a + b inside safeAdd; raw addition checked by assert.
balanceOf[_to] + _value overflow assert inside transfer; raw addition.
balanceOf[_to] + _value overflow assert inside transferFrom; raw addition.
owner.transfer(amount) external value call in withdrawEther; can invoke a contract owner.
